original.target_description: Original source located; page 20 Table 2 Pearson correlations; requested r lacks outcome/phase/electrode identification.

notes: Source title and DOI match the original reference. The supplied description names a family of stress/asymmetry/cortisol analyses, without specifying the critical electrode pair, phase, outcome index, or test contrast. No target chosen from audit ID, input order, or numeric matching. Explicit final analysis sample candidate: N=21 male participants, following exclusion of N=2 for premature CPT termination and N=1 for excessive movement artifacts (Methods 2.1, PDF p.8). Methods 2.9 (PDF p.13) explicitly calls N=21 the final sample size for the RFA repeated-measures analysis. This is a printed final N, not an N derived from df or a sum. Retained only as a candidate because exact row/test correspondence is unresolved; participant count is distinct from EEG epochs excluded for artifacts. Unassigned replication and reported_success are placeholders only. PDF p.20, Table 2 has 8 outcome rows and 10 asymmetry columns (Average Pre, Pre, During, Post, During-Pre at F3/F4 and F7/F8). Cortisol AUCg candidate r/p pairs, in that explicitly printed column sequence: -.546/.010, -.157/.496, -.512/.018, -.324/.152, -.364/.104, -.203/.377, -.385/.085, -.342/.129, -.248/.278, -.099/.670. Cortisol AUCi is a separate index; cardiovascular and subjective outcomes are also tabulated. None is uniquely identified by locator p.20. Section 3.3 (PDF pp.18-19) distinguishes same-day baseline cortisol r as printed ". -.512" with p=.018 from average-baseline r=-.546 with p=.010. No typo correction or metric conversion performed. Candidate final-sample evidence: Due to premature termination of the CPT (N=2) and excessive movement artifacts (N=1), three ... subjects needed to be excluded from final analysis, resulting in a total number of 21 ... participants (mean age: 26.5, range: 22-32 years).
